hooks.command: file=$(echo '$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in *bot.py|*db.py) echo '⚠️  Restart bot to apply changes: pkill -f bot.py && source .venv/bin/activate && python bot.py' ;; *.env.example) echo '💡 Remember to update your .env file with any new variables.' ;; esac
